{{Quote|Well, now I know who to call when I have an ocuvox infestation.|Rook Pryce taunts Obi-Wan Kenobi after he frightens off an ocuvox|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''Ocuvox''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of winged animal found in the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Members of the species had three [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a beak, and two [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Limb/Legends|feet]] as well as blue feathers covering their body and wings, apart from the tips of the wing which had purple feathers. Ocuvox wings also bore strips which glowed white in darkness. The winged animals were capable of squawking and were known to create infestations.<ref name="SC" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SCt">''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'' states the story is set during the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' which ''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' stated took place c. [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was on Wielu hunting a [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] criminal named [[T'mott Zoat]], and mistook the strips on an ocuvox's wings for his target's eyes. After slashing at the animal with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]], he caused it to fly away, and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]], who had witnessed the attack, taunted him for the mistake.<ref name="SC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ocuvox appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'', a digest sized [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] released in [[2013]]. It was written by [[Justin Aclin]] and illustrated by [[Eduardo Ferrara]].<ref name="SC" />
